cases.trigger: Original element with one issued atomic cell
cases.expected: Direct registered scalar; same exact payload, declared/actual type and original assessment; no legacy getters.

cases.trigger: Original attribute with one issued atomic cell
cases.expected: Same bounded result/provenance as element; attribute channel/tuple authenticated.

cases.trigger: Ordered typed list containing three cells and equal duplicate values
cases.expected: Materialized sequence preserves order, duplicate occurrences and per-ordinal marker identities.

cases.trigger: Union/list container with different actual member types
cases.expected: Each cell retains actual atomic member type; governing container type is not substituted.

cases.trigger: Explicit Undefined and no admitted snapshots
cases.expected: Undefined after current raw/advisor checks; zero node/facts/typed callbacks and slots.

cases.trigger: Element HasNoTypedValue=true with typed outcome/getters poisoned
cases.expected: InvalidOperationException with FOTY0012 prefix after current metadata proof; typed method untouched, zero slots.

cases.trigger: Supported empty atomic and supported empty list containers
cases.expected: Undefined; validated shape remains transient; no persistent empty-container record or slots.

cases.trigger: Nilled original element with supported empty container
cases.expected: Undefined after validating real supported emptiness; no inferred empty shortcut.

cases.trigger: Nilled plus absent, nilled nonempty, or attribute absent/nilled
cases.expected: ArgumentException for contradictory supported evidence; no successful empty or FOTY0012 masking.

cases.trigger: Unsupported/NotFound/Invalid/unknown/null typed outcomes and Supported-null container
cases.expected: Unsupported maps to NotSupportedException; all malformed outcomes reject before payload use/cache mutation.

cases.trigger: Missing annotated channel or selected original assessment
cases.expected: NotSupportedException; no legacy string/type/TypedValue fallback.

cases.trigger: Known document/text/comment/PI/namespace and invalid/combined kind
cases.expected: Known other kinds NotSupported before facts; unknown/combined malformed ArgumentException.

cases.trigger: Foreign, absent or ambiguously owned node
cases.expected: ArgumentException before NodeKind/OriginalSchemaFacts.

cases.trigger: Null/unissued/copied facts or wrong node/input/origin tuple
cases.expected: ArgumentException before facts metadata.

cases.trigger: Foreign type/declaration/origin, changed assessor/authority/environment and foreign/missing per-cell declared/actual/origin evidence
cases.expected: Current binding/component/tuple checks prevent delivery.

cases.trigger: Missing/extra/prefixed variable, direct atomic, array/map/function or sequence input
cases.expected: Closed capture refusal without callbacks/enumeration; missing variable is not empty.

cases.trigger: Focus, dynamic namespaces, services or populated execution state
cases.expected: NotSupportedException before node/facts access; same closed capture boundary.

cases.trigger: Syntax data(), data(.), paths/operators/aliases/EQNames or foreign fn mapping
cases.expected: Unsupported compilation before Bind; only two exact trimmed forms select profile.

cases.trigger: Canonical spelling, each of five limits, frozen CompileOptions mutation
cases.expected: Canonical forms agree; descriptor separates limits/static context and remains frozen.

cases.trigger: Container exceeds MaxTypedValueAtoms including empty/single/list fast paths
cases.expected: Refuse excess before Current; no partial result/entries and owned iterator cleanup exactly once.

cases.trigger: Whole new batch exceeds remaining scalar capacity
cases.expected: No partial install/eviction/unmarked fallback; previous entries/capacity remain valid for fitting retry.

cases.trigger: Repeated exact issued nonempty container and unchanged original tuple
cases.expected: Reauthenticate original metadata/outcome/identity each query; reuse existing cells/markers/slots without payload/iterator replay.

cases.trigger: Repeated fresh supported empty containers
cases.expected: No scalar/index growth; empty may be reread rather than kept in unbounded container cache.

cases.trigger: Equal payloads from distinct containers, ordinals, origins or admitted snapshots
cases.expected: Keys stay reference/scoped; no semantic-equality merging or node-identity key expansion.

cases.trigger: Precommit read/cleanup/allocation/insertion failure
cases.expected: No staged marker/output escape or partial registration; complete rollback before commit, original failure ordering retained.

cases.trigger: Postcommit cancellation, revocation or delivery failure
cases.expected: No result/prefix; complete batch remains installed unless snapshot close clears it; retry reuses identity.

cases.trigger: Same-key winner and remaining-capacity races
cases.expected: Use installed winner atomically; refusal never rolls back another operation or reserves capacity.

cases.trigger: Callback close/cancel/revocation and false ownership answers at all stages
cases.expected: No delivery, correct error category; raw cleanup waits for actual callback completion/consumption.

cases.trigger: Provider primary and iterator Dispose both fail
cases.expected: Original callback failure then cleanup failure in established aggregate order; no partial install/result.

cases.trigger: Metadata-only nilled and default complete facts-reader controls
cases.expected: Old defaults, NotRequested/Absent/Unsupported/Supported distinctions and guard-cost optimization remain unchanged.

cases.trigger: Enumerate materialized result repeatedly after raw completion/close
cases.expected: Copied carrier payload/order/count readable without provider calls; no active raw lifetime or authority implied.

cases.trigger: Reuse an extracted scalar in a later same-admission raw operation
cases.expected: Authenticate current container/input/origin/components; original resident marker reused, raw view itself remains expired.

cases.trigger: Extraction node/facts association revoked after successful extraction but container remains independently issued
cases.expected: Next extraction refuses; resident cell authorization follows current independent container/input/origin/component proof, not permanent node identity.

cases.trigger: Container/input/origin/component revoked, forged marker or altered scalar representation
cases.expected: Later resident-cell operational authorization refuses; retained payload/label is not proof.

cases.trigger: Return data output to another compiled session using same source/assessor
cases.expected: Foreign admission refuses; no implicit cross-session import, identity/numeric profile expansion or host adoption.

cases.trigger: Same issued container legitimately shared by two original nodes in one input/origin
cases.expected: Authenticate each extraction tuple; preserve existing container/ordinal key, no fictional parent identity or duplicate scalar slots.

cases.trigger: Multi-result buffer/wrapper allocation and commit winner selection
cases.expected: Allocate bounded unpublished storage before commit; fill only winning registered transports; publish only complete result after final facts/cell checks.

cases.trigger: Wide integers/decimals, scales, mixed supported atomic payloads plus default, structured or already-marked provider cells
cases.expected: Existing numeric bounds preserve exact representation; refuse excess without rounding/retyping or numeric-name inference. Malformed/nonplain cells reject before registration or output.

cases.trigger: Public Run and RunAsync plus source close/drain during extraction
cases.expected: Actual public compile/bind/admit/evaluate path qualified in both modes; source borrowed resource ownership remains correct.

cases.trigger: Cold/warm public data query, empty/list reuse and final full qualification
cases.expected: Record allocations/provider reads/retained slot accounting; exact binaries, full tests/QT3/qt4 skips and API/layout/friends; no native owner budget inference.
